title: Fred B NDE 104
content: Working alone. Grabbed a water pipe for balance. Got full electric shock across the heart -- 115 volts AC. Fell back to get off pipe -- don't remember hitting floor. Was floating in a black void, very happy -- no pain of any kind. Saw a light at my level, to the left. Swung that way and headed for the light, there was a texture to the light like the sun reflecting off water onto a white wall. As I moved to the light, I could hear a dog howling, got louder as I got closer. All of a sudden, the incredible happiness was gone, and I was back in my voltage racked body. The dog howl -- was me! Some primeval survival instinct had kicked in. The sound brought a co-worker from two rooms away, and got me off the pipe-drill motor connection. I was able to change the dog-howl to the word, 'Help.' He took me to an Emergency Room and they could find nothing wrong! When I related the incident, the doctor estimated by evidence that I was dead for ten to twenty seconds. I have had no residual effects, except I'm no longer afraid of dying, and appreciate everything in my life more.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Clinical death The Dr. said I was most likely dead for 10-20 seconds. Accidental electrocution.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Void | Darkness | Light
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Time had no meaning -- eternity.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes Sunlight reflecting off water onto a white wall (like in 'Poltergeist' movie).
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Incredible happiness and lack of pain.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will The snap-back with the dog-howl.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will The snap-back with the dog-howl. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes Take more time to, 'Stop and Smell the Roses!'
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Take more time to, 'Stop and Smell the Roses!' After the NDE
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Best -- the black-void/light experience. Worse -- snapping back into my tortured body.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes They all said that I was 'sent back' because my reason for being on Earth was not over yet.
